QuestInfo.name: One Last Gift for Blake
QuestInfo.0: Blake is still not here. Enin is starting to worry.
QuestInfo.1: Enin wants to get another gift for Blake before he arrives! She wants Orange Mushroom Dolls this time.
QuestInfo.2: You brought back all the Orange Mushroom Dolls that Enin wanted. Blake better show up before Enin runs you ragged.

0.0: Blake's still not here. Could...something have happened to him? I think keeping his fans waiting like this may anger them...
0.1: The latest rumors say that Blake's a changed man now. Something about him becoming very arrogant after he got famous. These rumors are probably false, but Blake should still be careful. Sigh... I'm so worried.
0.2: No, this is the time when I must stay strong and show my support for my love! I should get him another gift. Just in case. You'll help me again, right?

yes.0: What should I get him... Ah, how about the Kerning Square specialty, Orange Mushroom Dolls? Blake will most definitely like 'em. They're such perfect bedtime companions, you know. So, can you get #b65 Orange Mushroom Dolls#k?

no.0: Oh come on, are you really going to bail on me now? After all we've been through?

1.0: Yay, look at all these adorable Orange Mushroom Dolls! Blake will definitely be pleased.

yes.0: What's everyone freaking out abOH MY GOSH it's Blake! BLAKE! BLAAAAAAAAKE!

item.0: Could you bring back 65 Orange Mushroom Dolls?
